jobs.title: Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.

As Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

What will you do?

Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI-first organization.
Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API-first, event-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real-time decision-making, and agile business capability delivery.
Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end-to-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
Build and lead high-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.
Deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and scaling AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
Expert-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Proficiency with both legacy and modern data technologies. Strong foundation in data governance, quality, integration, and analytics.
Integration platform and modernization expertise: Experience leading the transformation of legacy integration infrastructure to modern architectures. Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven systems, and hybrid technology ecosystems
Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C-level.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
Hands-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).
Experience in leading AI adoption and scaling development practices. Established and/or Chaired AI Centers of Excellence that drove organizational AI adoption.
Experience leading successful data modernization programs on multi-platform hybrid environments in large enterprises.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President (SVP)-  Toronto Financial Services
jobs.description:
SVP, Sector Leader - Toronto Financial Services

Reporting to the BU Leader, Toronto Financial Services | Toronto, Ontario | Full P&L Accountability

Lead the transformation of one of CGI Canada's largest Financial Services businesses. Shape the future of consulting, AI-enabled services, and client partnerships while building the next generation of growth. Build the business our clients will need tomorrow, not the business we've built yesterday.

The Opportunity:

Toronto Financial Services is entering its next phase of growth.

As AI reshapes the industry and client expectations evolve, Artificial Intelligence is transforming how clients operate. Global Capability Centres are reshaping delivery models. Market disruption is accelerating, and clients increasingly expect strategic business outcomes, not simply technology implementations.

CGI is investing in a leader who can accelerate growth, strengthen executive relationships, expand consulting-led engagements, and position CGI as the partner of choice for business and technology transformation.

Our success will come from bringing together the full capabilities of CGI to solve client business problems through Business Consulting, Systems Integration, Managed Services, AI-enabled services, reusable IP, and strategic partnerships.

This role exists to build the future. You will lead one of CGI Canada's largest Financial Services businesses with full accountability for growth, profitability, client relationships, delivery excellence, and leadership development. Success will be measured by growing the business through the full capabilities of CGI, rather than maximizing individual service lines.

Your future duties and responsibilities

What You'll Deliver:

Accelerate Growth

Drive organic growth and win new business across Managed Services, Systems Integration, Business Consulting, and IP, both within existing client ecosystems and in new markets.

Elevate Business Consulting

Position Business Consulting as a primary driver of transformational engagements. Increase consulting-led opportunities that create long-term strategic partnerships and expand CGI's influence within client organizations.

Drive Profitable Growth

Improve profitability through disciplined portfolio management, innovative commercial models, and operational excellence. Shift the business toward higher-value, outcome-based engagements while strengthening contribution margins.

Build AI into the Business

Use AI to improve productivity, delivery, and client outcomes while creating new revenue opportunities through AI-enabled services.

Build a High-Performing Culture

Build a leadership bench and a culture that attracts exceptional talent. Simplify the operating model so growth does not require proportional headcount, while creating an environment where energy, collaboration, and belonging thrive.

Create New Demand

Increase CGI's visibility with clients, alliance partners, and the market through measurable client outcomes, strategic relationships, and thought leadership.

Grow Through Partnerships

Leverage hyperscaler and technology alliances together with client co-innovation to expand CGI's reach beyond existing relationships and create new opportunities for growth.

Who You'll Work With

Reports to the BU Leader, Financial Services.
Leads Vice-Presidents and Directors across Consulting, Delivery, and Client Management.
Partners with enterprise leaders across Business Consulting, IP/AI, HR, Marketing, and Operations.
Builds strategic relationships with alliance partners and industry leaders.
Engages directly with C-suite executives across the client base.

The Operating Code

Own It

Solve problems early with accountability and ownership.

Move at the Speed of the Opportunity

Make timely decisions. Clients will not wait.

Bring Ideas Before They're Asked For

Shape the agenda rather than reacting to it.

Make AI Non-Negotiable

Ensure AI fluency across the leadership team and the business.

Protect the Standard

Maintain quality, delivery excellence, and client trust under all circumstances.

Say the Hard Thing Early

Lead with transparency and clarity to build stronger businesses.

Prove It With Numbers

Measure success through outcomes and business impact.

Make Noise About What Works

Recognize and share success so best practices can be adopted across the business.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

What You've Done Before

Built or scaled a consulting, technology, or managed services business with full P&L accountability, growing revenue and margin together.
Driven organic growth and new client acquisition across multiple service lines, not just one.
Led executive-level client relationships and secured large, strategic engagements, including opportunities developed before formal procurement.
Converted staff augmentation or time-and-materials engagements into outcome-based commercial models.
Built leadership teams, succession plans, and market visibility through analyst relations, media engagement, and industry recognition.
Led AI adoption across a leadership team, not just personally.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an MBA is an asset.

Success Looks Like

Three years from now:

Revenue has outpaced the market.
Business Consulting represents a larger share of the business.
AI-enabled services generate meaningful revenue.
Contribution margins have improved.
Clients engage CGI earlier and more strategically.
Leaders have grown into broader enterprise roles.
Capabilities developed within the sector are leveraged across Toronto Financial Services.

**This role is an existing vacancy.**

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

jobs.title: Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
Our VP, FP&A is a strategic partner and a critical enterprise leader who shapes how the business plans, allocates capital, measures performance, and makes decisions. This role combines deep financial expertise with strong executive presence, business acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex, franchise system.

As we shift toward a Product Operating Model, this leader will modernize FP&A into a proactive, insight-driven, technology-enabled function. They will help guide the business through this evolution, bringing structure, clarity, challenge, and strategic framing to elevate financial maturity across the organization.

The VP, FP&A must be both a relationship-builder and a systems thinker — equally comfortable diving into models, simplifying complexity, coaching a tactical FP&A team, and advising senior leaders with confidence and credibility.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

CFO Partnership & Executive Influence

Serve as trusted advisor to the CFO, providing structure, insight, guidance, and challenge on key decisions.
Strengthen the CFO’s influence by preparing high-quality narratives, decision frameworks, and financial storytelling for the Executive.
Bring clarity to ambiguity — shaping options, risks, and trade-offs in a way that enables confident decision-making.
Uplift FP&A capability and bring discipline to planning, forecasting, scenario thinking, and enterprise prioritization.

Modernize FP&A for a Product Operating Model

Translate traditional FP&A into a future-state model aligned with product planning, value streams, capacity-based resourcing, and multi-quarter bets.
Align financial rhythms with product cycles, investment governance, and product portfolio management.
Build FP&A frameworks that support experimentation, iterative planning, and benefit realization.

Enterprise Planning & Forecasting Leadership

Lead the company’s planning cycles: annual plan, rolling forecast, and long-term model.
Ensure assumptions, targets, and resource allocations align with strategy and enterprise priorities.
Elevate forecasting accuracy and enforce strong financial discipline across functions and brands.

Performance Management & Decision Support

Build standardized KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that unify financial and operational performance.
Run monthly and quarterly business reviews with a focus on insight, action, and accountability.
Provide functional and brand leaders with high-quality decision support, scenario analysis, and commercial insight.
Connect franchisor, brand, and franchise partner economics into a clear view of system-wide value creation.

Investment Governance & Capital Allocation

Operate the investment governance framework: ROI, payback, prioritization, and benefit realization.
Support the CFO in modeling and communicating enterprise value, including key drivers and risk factors.
Ensure investment decisions are aligned with strategic priorities and supported by clear financial logic.

FP&A Technology, Systems & Data Modernization

Modernize FP&A processes through improved systems, automation, and real-time insight (Cube, NetSuite, Tableau).
Strengthen data flows to eliminate manual overhead and improve the accuracy and speed of business insights.
Ensure the Finance team remains effective during the transition by supporting Excel- and Sheets-based processes while building toward a more automated future state.

Leadership, Culture & Team Development

Lead, coach, and elevate a high-performing FP&A team
Build a culture of clarity, curiosity, accountability, and cross-functional partnership.
Increase the commercial, analytical, and business-partnering capability of FP&A professionals.
Model behaviors aligned with the Product Operating Model: transparency, collaboration, system thinking, and customer obsession.

What You Bring To The Table

Proven experience leading FP&A in complex, multi-stakeholder, or high-growth environments, with accountability for forecasting, planning, analysis, and decision support.
Demonstrated success as a strategic partner to a CFO or senior executive, providing backbone support, structured thinking, and trusted challenge.
Strong understanding of how FP&A evolves in a Product Operating Model (value streams, portfolio planning, capacity modeling, investment governance, benefit realization).
Executive presence and relationship strength — able to build trust quickly, influence without friction, and communicate with clarity.
Technical and process depth, including financial modeling, scenario planning, and the ability to build, audit, and simplify models in Excel/Sheets.
Experience modernizing FP&A systems and data flows (Cube, Adaptive, Anaplan, Power BI, Tableau).
High EQ, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.
Formal credentials (CPA, CFA, MBA) are an asset, not a requirement.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Team members in our Vancouver, Toronto, and Kansas City Junktion Hubs follow a hybrid work model that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration. Employees are expected to work from the office several days each month, with scheduled team collaboration and company connection days to support alignment, teamwork, and business priorities.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive Salary (Actual salary offered will be commensurate with education, experience and internal parity)
Total Compensation Package designed to support your financial, personal, and professional well-being. This includes:
Participation in our Company Profit Sharing Program
Comprehensive Extended Health & Dental Benefits
Generous Paid Time Off, including annual vacation and personal days
Hybrid Work Environment, offering flexibility to work both remotely and from our corporate offices
Professional Development Opportunities to support ongoing career growth
Access to Health and Wellness Programs
Speak to us to learn more about what we offer

THE HIRING PROCESS

Pre-Screen – Let’s talk about your experience, goals & excitement for this role!
Interviews – Two or more interviews with different team members, including structured competency & scenario-based questions
Presentation/Assessment
References & Background Check
We use audio recording transcription for our interview practices

About Us

Did you know O2E Brands has been voted one of the Best Workplaces in Canada 14 times!? Take a sneak peek into why that is, here: (YouTube) Check us out on social!

At O2E Brands, we know that great talent comes in many forms, and we want to meet you at your best. We value diversity and inclusivity. We will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities at any time throughout the recruitment and selection process upon request.

Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply today!

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

jobs.description:
English to follow

Western Alliance Logistics, une division de Western Alliance, est une entreprise de logistique 3PL en pleine croissance spécialisée dans le transport de marchandises. Fondée en 2015 et établie à Montréal, nous transportons des marchandises par camion, train, avion et bateau partout au Canada, aux États-Unis et au Mexique.

Notre croissance s’accélère à travers plusieurs entités et nous recherchons un leader en finance capable d’apporter structure, visibilité et rigueur à notre fonction financière. Le ou la directeur(trice) des finances est responsable de l’ensemble de la fonction financière et travaille directement avec les propriétaires de l’entreprise sur les décisions qui façonnent son avenir.

Principales responsabilités

▪ Diriger la fonction financière pour l’ensemble des entités du groupe : comptabilité, comptes clients, comptes fournisseurs, paie et rapports financiers

▪ Superviser les clôtures mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles, la consolidation ainsi que la préparation des états financiers

▪ Élaborer les budgets, les prévisions et les projections de flux de trésorerie, et présenter les écarts à l’équipe de direction

▪ Fournir des analyses de marge et de profit brut par voie de transport, client et représentant des ventes afin d’appuyer les décisions commerciales

▪ Gérer les relations bancaires, les facilités de crédit, la trésorerie et l’exposition multidevise (CAD/USD)

▪ Concevoir et mettre en place des contrôles internes, des processus d’approbation et des politiques financières

▪ Diriger l’audit ou la mission d’examen de fin d’exercice et gérer les relations avec les comptables externes et les conseillers fiscaux

▪ Superviser la conformité relative à la TPS/TVQ, à l’impôt des sociétés et aux remises gouvernementales dans les différentes juridictions

▪ Piloter l’automatisation et l’amélioration des systèmes liés à l’ERP, au TMS et aux outils de veille stratégique et de production de rapports

▪ Développer l’équipe des finances — contrôleur, comptes clients, comptes fournisseurs et paie — grâce à l’accompagnement et à des objectifs clairs

Qualifications

▪ Titre de CPA

▪ Plus de 5 ans d’expérience progressive en leadership financier, incluant la consolidation de plusieurs entités

▪ Excellente maîtrise des systèmes ERP et des outils de production de rapports (Sage 300, Claude ou équivalent)

▪ Maîtrise avancée d’Excel et grande aisance à travailler avec d’importants ensembles de données

▪ Bilingue — français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit

Profil recherché

▪ Une personne qui met en place des systèmes plutôt que de contourner les processus existants

▪ Un excellent communicateur ou une excellente communicatrice capable de rendre les données financières claires et pertinentes pour les gestionnaires non financiers

▪ Une personne à l’aise d’être directement impliquée dans les opérations d’une entreprise en croissance — stratégie le matin, feuilles de calcul l’après-midi

Ce que WAL vous offre

▪ Un accès direct aux propriétaires de l’entreprise et une réelle influence sur les décisions stratégiques

▪ Une fonction financière que vous aurez l’occasion de structurer et de développer

▪ Une visibilité sur toutes les facettes du secteur de la logistique et du transport

▪ Une culture d’entreprise dynamique, axée sur la croissance

Avantages sociaux

▪ Régime complet d’avantages sociaux — soins dentaires, soins de santé complémentaires, assurance invalidité et assurance vie

▪ Programme d’aide aux employés (PAE)

▪ Congés payés

▪ Gym sur place et stationnement gratuit

▪ Événements d’entreprise et initiatives de santé et mieux-être

Prêt(e) à discuter?

Envoyez votre CV à phunt@westernalliancelogistics.com — les candidatures seront examinées au fur et à mesure de leur réception.

Western Alliance Logistics, a division of Western Alliance, is a fast-growing 3PL logistics company specializing in freight forwarding. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Montréal, we move freight by truck, rail, air and sea across Canada, the United States and Mexico.

We are scaling quickly across multiple entities and need a finance leader who can bring structure, visibility and discipline to the numbers. The Director of Finance owns the entire finance function and works directly with ownership on the decisions that shape the business.

Key responsibilities

▪ Lead the finance function across all entities in the group — accounting, AR, AP, payroll and reporting

▪ Own the monthly, quarterly and annual close, consolidation and financial statement preparation

▪ Build budgets, forecasts and cash-flow projections, and report variances to the executive team

▪ Deliver margin and gross-profit analytics by lane, customer and salesperson to drive commercial decisions

▪ Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, treasury and multi-currency (CAD/USD) exposure

▪ Design and enforce internal controls, approval frameworks and finance policy

▪ Lead the year-end audit or review and manage external accountants and tax advisors

▪ Oversee GST/QST, corporate tax and government remittance compliance across jurisdictions

▪ Drive automation and system improvement across the ERP, the TMS and business intelligence reporting

▪ Develop the finance team — Controller, AR, AP and payroll — through coaching and clear objectives

Qualifications

▪ CPA designation

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.

As Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

What will you do?

Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI-first organization.
Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API-first, event-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real-time decision-making, and agile business capability delivery.
Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end-to-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
Build and lead high-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.
Deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and scaling AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
Expert-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Proficiency with both legacy and modern data technologies. Strong foundation in data governance, quality, integration, and analytics.
Integration platform and modernization expertise: Experience leading the transformation of legacy integration infrastructure to modern architectures. Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven systems, and hybrid technology ecosystems
Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C-level.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
Hands-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).
Experience in leading AI adoption and scaling development practices. Established and/or Chaired AI Centers of Excellence that drove organizational AI adoption.
Experience leading successful data modernization programs on multi-platform hybrid environments in large enterprises.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis
new_jobs.description:
Our VP, FP&A is a strategic partner and a critical enterprise leader who shapes how the business plans, allocates capital, measures performance, and makes decisions. This role combines deep financial expertise with strong executive presence, business acumen, and the ability to influence across a complex, franchise system.

As we shift toward a Product Operating Model, this leader will modernize FP&A into a proactive, insight-driven, technology-enabled function. They will help guide the business through this evolution, bringing structure, clarity, challenge, and strategic framing to elevate financial maturity across the organization.

The VP, FP&A must be both a relationship-builder and a systems thinker — equally comfortable diving into models, simplifying complexity, coaching a tactical FP&A team, and advising senior leaders with confidence and credibility.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

CFO Partnership & Executive Influence

Serve as trusted advisor to the CFO, providing structure, insight, guidance, and challenge on key decisions.
Strengthen the CFO’s influence by preparing high-quality narratives, decision frameworks, and financial storytelling for the Executive.
Bring clarity to ambiguity — shaping options, risks, and trade-offs in a way that enables confident decision-making.
Uplift FP&A capability and bring discipline to planning, forecasting, scenario thinking, and enterprise prioritization.

Modernize FP&A for a Product Operating Model

Translate traditional FP&A into a future-state model aligned with product planning, value streams, capacity-based resourcing, and multi-quarter bets.
Align financial rhythms with product cycles, investment governance, and product portfolio management.
Build FP&A frameworks that support experimentation, iterative planning, and benefit realization.

Enterprise Planning & Forecasting Leadership

Lead the company’s planning cycles: annual plan, rolling forecast, and long-term model.
Ensure assumptions, targets, and resource allocations align with strategy and enterprise priorities.
Elevate forecasting accuracy and enforce strong financial discipline across functions and brands.

Performance Management & Decision Support

Build standardized KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that unify financial and operational performance.
Run monthly and quarterly business reviews with a focus on insight, action, and accountability.
Provide functional and brand leaders with high-quality decision support, scenario analysis, and commercial insight.
Connect franchisor, brand, and franchise partner economics into a clear view of system-wide value creation.

Investment Governance & Capital Allocation

Operate the investment governance framework: ROI, payback, prioritization, and benefit realization.
Support the CFO in modeling and communicating enterprise value, including key drivers and risk factors.
Ensure investment decisions are aligned with strategic priorities and supported by clear financial logic.

FP&A Technology, Systems & Data Modernization

Modernize FP&A processes through improved systems, automation, and real-time insight (Cube, NetSuite, Tableau).
Strengthen data flows to eliminate manual overhead and improve the accuracy and speed of business insights.
Ensure the Finance team remains effective during the transition by supporting Excel- and Sheets-based processes while building toward a more automated future state.

Leadership, Culture & Team Development

Lead, coach, and elevate a high-performing FP&A team
Build a culture of clarity, curiosity, accountability, and cross-functional partnership.
Increase the commercial, analytical, and business-partnering capability of FP&A professionals.
Model behaviors aligned with the Product Operating Model: transparency, collaboration, system thinking, and customer obsession.

What You Bring To The Table

Proven experience leading FP&A in complex, multi-stakeholder, or high-growth environments, with accountability for forecasting, planning, analysis, and decision support.
Demonstrated success as a strategic partner to a CFO or senior executive, providing backbone support, structured thinking, and trusted challenge.
Strong understanding of how FP&A evolves in a Product Operating Model (value streams, portfolio planning, capacity modeling, investment governance, benefit realization).
Executive presence and relationship strength — able to build trust quickly, influence without friction, and communicate with clarity.
Technical and process depth, including financial modeling, scenario planning, and the ability to build, audit, and simplify models in Excel/Sheets.
Experience modernizing FP&A systems and data flows (Cube, Adaptive, Anaplan, Power BI, Tableau).
High EQ, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.
Formal credentials (CPA, CFA, MBA) are an asset, not a requirement.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Team members in our Vancouver, Toronto, and Kansas City Junktion Hubs follow a hybrid work model that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration. Employees are expected to work from the office several days each month, with scheduled team collaboration and company connection days to support alignment, teamwork, and business priorities.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive Salary (Actual salary offered will be commensurate with education, experience and internal parity)
Total Compensation Package designed to support your financial, personal, and professional well-being. This includes:
Participation in our Company Profit Sharing Program
Comprehensive Extended Health & Dental Benefits
Generous Paid Time Off, including annual vacation and personal days
Hybrid Work Environment, offering flexibility to work both remotely and from our corporate offices
Professional Development Opportunities to support ongoing career growth
Access to Health and Wellness Programs
Speak to us to learn more about what we offer

THE HIRING PROCESS

Interviews – Two or more interviews with different team members, including structured competency & scenario-based questions
Presentation/Assessment

We use audio recording transcription for our interview practices

new_jobs.description:
English to follow

Western Alliance Logistics, une division de Western Alliance, est une entreprise de logistique 3PL en pleine croissance spécialisée dans le transport de marchandises. Fondée en 2015 et établie à Montréal, nous transportons des marchandises par camion, train, avion et bateau partout au Canada, aux États-Unis et au Mexique.

Notre croissance s’accélère à travers plusieurs entités et nous recherchons un leader en finance capable d’apporter structure, visibilité et rigueur à notre fonction financière. Le ou la directeur(trice) des finances est responsable de l’ensemble de la fonction financière et travaille directement avec les propriétaires de l’entreprise sur les décisions qui façonnent son avenir.

Principales responsabilités

▪ Diriger la fonction financière pour l’ensemble des entités du groupe : comptabilité, comptes clients, comptes fournisseurs, paie et rapports financiers

▪ Superviser les clôtures mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles, la consolidation ainsi que la préparation des états financiers

▪ Élaborer les budgets, les prévisions et les projections de flux de trésorerie, et présenter les écarts à l’équipe de direction

▪ Fournir des analyses de marge et de profit brut par voie de transport, client et représentant des ventes afin d’appuyer les décisions commerciales

▪ Gérer les relations bancaires, les facilités de crédit, la trésorerie et l’exposition multidevise (CAD/USD)

▪ Concevoir et mettre en place des contrôles internes, des processus d’approbation et des politiques financières

▪ Diriger l’audit ou la mission d’examen de fin d’exercice et gérer les relations avec les comptables externes et les conseillers fiscaux

▪ Superviser la conformité relative à la TPS/TVQ, à l’impôt des sociétés et aux remises gouvernementales dans les différentes juridictions

▪ Piloter l’automatisation et l’amélioration des systèmes liés à l’ERP, au TMS et aux outils de veille stratégique et de production de rapports

▪ Développer l’équipe des finances — contrôleur, comptes clients, comptes fournisseurs et paie — grâce à l’accompagnement et à des objectifs clairs

Qualifications

▪ Titre de CPA

▪ Plus de 5 ans d’expérience progressive en leadership financier, incluant la consolidation de plusieurs entités

▪ Excellente maîtrise des systèmes ERP et des outils de production de rapports (Sage 300, Claude ou équivalent)

▪ Maîtrise avancée d’Excel et grande aisance à travailler avec d’importants ensembles de données

▪ Bilingue — français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit

Profil recherché

▪ Une personne qui met en place des systèmes plutôt que de contourner les processus existants

▪ Un excellent communicateur ou une excellente communicatrice capable de rendre les données financières claires et pertinentes pour les gestionnaires non financiers

▪ Une personne à l’aise d’être directement impliquée dans les opérations d’une entreprise en croissance — stratégie le matin, feuilles de calcul l’après-midi

Ce que WAL vous offre

▪ Un accès direct aux propriétaires de l’entreprise et une réelle influence sur les décisions stratégiques

▪ Une fonction financière que vous aurez l’occasion de structurer et de développer

▪ Une visibilité sur toutes les facettes du secteur de la logistique et du transport

▪ Une culture d’entreprise dynamique, axée sur la croissance

Avantages sociaux

▪ Régime complet d’avantages sociaux — soins dentaires, soins de santé complémentaires, assurance invalidité et assurance vie

▪ Programme d’aide aux employés (PAE)

▪ Congés payés

▪ Gym sur place et stationnement gratuit

▪ Événements d’entreprise et initiatives de santé et mieux-être

Prêt(e) à discuter?

Envoyez votre CV à phunt@westernalliancelogistics.com — les candidatures seront examinées au fur et à mesure de leur réception.

Western Alliance Logistics, a division of Western Alliance, is a fast-growing 3PL logistics company specializing in freight forwarding. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Montréal, we move freight by truck, rail, air and sea across Canada, the United States and Mexico.

We are scaling quickly across multiple entities and need a finance leader who can bring structure, visibility and discipline to the numbers. The Director of Finance owns the entire finance function and works directly with ownership on the decisions that shape the business.

Key responsibilities

▪ Lead the finance function across all entities in the group — accounting, AR, AP, payroll and reporting

▪ Own the monthly, quarterly and annual close, consolidation and financial statement preparation

▪ Build budgets, forecasts and cash-flow projections, and report variances to the executive team

▪ Deliver margin and gross-profit analytics by lane, customer and salesperson to drive commercial decisions

▪ Manage banking relationships, credit facilities, treasury and multi-currency (CAD/USD) exposure

▪ Design and enforce internal controls, approval frameworks and finance policy

▪ Lead the year-end audit or review and manage external accountants and tax advisors

▪ Oversee GST/QST, corporate tax and government remittance compliance across jurisdictions

▪ Drive automation and system improvement across the ERP, the TMS and business intelligence reporting

▪ Develop the finance team — Controller, AR, AP and payroll — through coaching and clear objectives

Qualifications

▪ 5+ years of progressive finance leadership, including multi-entity consolidation

▪ Advanced Excel and genuine comfort working with large data sets

▪ Exposure to every corner of logistics and transportation

▪ Fast-paced, growth-driven company culture
